हिमवत् a. Snowy, icy, frosty. --m.
The Himālaya mountain; R. 4. 79,
V. 5. 22.
--Comp.
--कुक्षिः a valley
of the Himālaya.

--सुतः the
Maināka mountain.

the Ganges.

1 [महद् हिमं, आनुक्] A mass
or collection of snow, snow-drift;
नगमुपरि हिमानीगौरमासाद्य जिष्णुः
Ki. 4. 38; Bv. 1. 26.
--2 A kind of
sugar.

हिमेलु a. Suffering from cold,
chilly, frozen.

हिम्य a.
1 Snowy, frosty.
--2 Cold,
frigid.
